_about: How a group filing weights the book of each reporting entity, by the rule of the text that governs the filing — never an institution switch or a platform default (E75). Each regime gives the factor per consolidation method of an entity's link to its parent: 'full' (a subsidiary, the whole book), 'proportional' (a jointly managed undertaking, its ownership share), 'equity' (an equity-method holding — the associate's book is not consolidated; the holding itself is an exposure of the parent). Every quote is checked word for word against the official texts held in data/sources/legal (services.reference.legal_texts). A framework's regime is either the text's own rule (basis 'text', the refs that set it) or a reading Tellumen declares where the governing text sets no scope of its own (basis 'declared'). The file is on the regulatory-change route (services.regspec.rules): two people sign its exact sha256, any edit voids the sign-off, and every group filing stamps the record and the sha it was computed on. The ESRS statement's scope is not here: it is the undertaking's group as ESRS 1 §62 sets it, with joint ventures and joint operations told apart (services.governance.esrs_statement.scope).
title: Consolidation rules

act.title: Consolidation scope of group filings — CRR Part One Title II, Solvency II Delegated Regulation Art. 335, Accounting Directive Art. 27, Taxonomy Art. 8 Delegated Act Annexes I, III, V

crr_prudential.label: CRR prudential consolidation (Pillar 3; a credit institution's Taxonomy KPIs)

refs.quote: EU parent institutions shall comply with Part Eight on the basis of their consolidated situation.
shall be consolidated proportionally according to the share of capital held, where the liability of those undertakings is limited to the share of the capital they hold.
In particular, they may permit or require the use of the equity method. That method shall not, however, constitute inclusion of the undertakings concerned in supervision on a consolidated basis.
it shall apply the equity method to that subsidiary or participation. That method shall not, however, constitute inclusion of the undertakings concerned in supervision on a consolidated basis.
Credit institutions shall disclose relevant KPIs on the basis of the scope of their prudential consolidation determined in accordance with Regulation (EU) No 575/2013, Title II, Chapter 2, Section 2.

solvency2_method1.label: Solvency II group solvency, method 1 (consolidated data)

refs.quote: full consolidation of data of all the insurance or reinsurance undertakings, third-country insurance or reinsurance undertakings, insurance holding companies, mixed financial holding companies and ancillary services undertakings which are subsidiaries of the parent undertaking;
where those undertakings' responsibility is limited to the share of the capital they hold;
on the basis of the adjusted equity method in accordance with Article 13(3), data of all holdings in related insurance or reinsurance undertakings

accounting_group.label: The group of the consolidated financial statements (a non-financial undertaking's or an asset manager's Taxonomy KPIs)

refs.quote: the KPIs shall be provided at the level of the individual undertaking where that undertaking prepares only individual non-financial statements or at the level of the group where the undertaking prepares consolidated non-financial statements.

provide the KPIs at the level of the individual asset manager where that undertaking prepares only individual non-financial statements or at the level of the group where the undertaking prepares consolidated non-financial statements.

Where an undertaking included in a consolidation has an associated undertaking, that associated undertaking shall be shown in the consolidated balance sheet as a separate item with an appropriate heading.
